paper_metadata.title: Improving the high temperature mechanical performance of Cu–Cr alloy induced by residual nano-sized Cr precipitates

evidence.quote: Cu-Cr alloy
The mechanical performance of Cu – Cr alloy severely deteriorates at high temperatures due to the Cr precipitates coarsening rapidly or dissolving in Cu matrix again.

evidence.section: 3.4 The strengthening effect at high temperature induced by residual Cr precipitates
evidence.quote: The strengthening effect of a particle in metal matrix composites is usually evaluated by Orowan strengthening, i.e., the fine Cr precipitate act as an obstacle to hinder the dislocation movement in the Cu matrix
